items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Alan Ganley for instance, who I’ve known Gan many years, unfailingly courteous. And I mean I quite often review his big band.

ctx.x: Do you get positive feedback too?

Yes. It is pleasing if a musician makes the point. Alan Ganley for instance, who I’ve known Gan many years, unfailingly courteous. And I mean I quite often review his big band. He has a rather fine big band. He would always telephone. And that’s very nice. It’s courteous and there’s a sense of it being something we’re both in together. I mean I feel I’m part of it in the sense that I’m trying to support it if you follow me. Other musicians have dropped me a line or rung me up and said look, you’ve got it right…
